versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Financial Statement Explainer skill.

- Provides plain-English explanations of P&L, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
- Walks section-by-section through statements, highlighting key line items and ratios relevant to the user.
- Explains the overall story behind the numbers for non-finance readers.
- Flags missing data, never invents or computes figures not provided.
- Includes pointers for next questions and always clarifies this is not financial advice.
